ev_charging_demand_kwh.long_description: Total simulated EV charging energy delivered (kWh) within the county at a given hour of day, summed across all charging locations including residential, public, and other charging points. This is a typical-day hourly profile: each `datetime` value (e.g., 2026-01-01T07:00:00) represents the hour-of-day, not a specific calendar date.
ev_charging_demand_kwh.short_description: EV charging energy demand (kWh) per county per hour-of-day, 2026 typical-day profile.
ev_charging_demand_kwh.provenance: Simulated VA charging-event records aggregated to (county, hour-of-day) by summing total_kWh_added. Source files are tagged with the scenario va_2026_run2_eval30. Charging-location lat/lon were spatial-joined to 2020 Census county boundaries to assign FIPS.

n_active_charging_locations.long_description: Number of distinct EV charging locations within the county that delivered energy during a given hour of day. Counts unique charging_station_id values with non-zero total_kWh_added, so a single location contributing to multiple hours of the day is counted once per hour.
n_active_charging_locations.short_description: Distinct active EV charging locations per county per hour-of-day, 2026 typical-day profile.
n_active_charging_locations.provenance: Simulated VA charging-event records aggregated to (county, hour-of-day) by counting distinct charging_station_id values with kWh > 0. Source scenario: va_2026_run2_eval30.
